title: Candy Panic: Haunted Night
author: historic_ohio
selftext: Candy Panic is a fast-paced, addictive 2D vertical game where players catch falling holiday treats. As night falls, a colorful cascade of candy corn, chocolate bars, and pumpkin sweets rains down from the top of the screen. Players must swipe rapidly to guide their jack-o'-lantern basket, gathering points while dodging dangerous falling tricks like glowing ghosts and poisonous green potions. Each successful catch speeds up the descent, building intense arcade-style tension. Perfect for quick mobile sessions, this spooky seasonal title combines simple, responsive touch controls with charming retro pixel art to deliver vibrant, festive fun
